asset.description: The vehicle or plant item the checklist is about; the required subject anchor.

attributes.description: Every remaining form answer keyed by the tenant's own question text, plus `_raw_metadata` at rest. This is where the **82 checklist answer slugs**, the **152 tenant-derived identity/vehicle slugs** and the **15 excluded tenant-authored keys** live; all are counted, not named (SC002).

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The accounting period the inspection falls in, derived from `occurred_at`.

flagged_item_count.description: Number of checklist answers whose **value** names a fault, derived from the response vocabulary by `form_measures`.

form_id.description: The Assignar form-template id, the stable twin of `form_title`.

form_title.description: The matched Assignar form's title — which inspection instrument this fact is.

inspection_date.description: The date the form itself carries, distinct from submission time.

occurred_at.description: When the inspection was submitted; the event time and the retention clock start.

odometer.description: The odometer or meter reading the inspection captured.

project.description: The project the inspection is recorded against.

source_system.description: Originating system; `ASSIGNAR` today and the only system the frozen universe names.

unanswered_item_count.description: Number of answerable checklist questions left blank.

worker.description: The worker who submitted or signed the inspection.
